stages.name: Question
stages.en: Can visual observations and physical interventions reveal the causal structure?

stages.name: Pixel readout and calibration
stages.en: An anchored visual encoder reads seven states. Known target commands calibrate these readings.

stages.name: Observational graph
stages.en: 512 observation images produce this initial graph; 6 links remain unoriented.

stages.name: Select 1
stages.en: Round 1: select pusher (P) from the unresolved links.

stages.name: initial
stages.en: The scene starts upright, before the selected operation.

stages.name: root_approach
stages.en: The upstream gripper approaches the pusher.

stages.name: root_hold
stages.en: Hold the pusher at its inactive position (P=0).

stages.name: observe
stages.en: Wait for the scene to settle before collecting the readout.

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Paired trial: same initial context, opposite target command.

stages.name: initial
stages.en: The scene starts upright, before the selected operation.

stages.name: root_approach
stages.en: The upstream gripper approaches the pusher.

stages.name: root_push
stages.en: The upstream gripper pushes the pusher; observe how the scene responds.

stages.name: root_retract
stages.en: The gripper withdraws after contact.

stages.name: observe
stages.en: Wait for the scene to settle before collecting the readout.

stages.name: Direct evidence 1
stages.en: The full batch supports 2 new edge directions, shown in blue.

stages.name: Graph update 1
stages.en: Graph rules orient 4 more links. All 6 links are now oriented.

stages.name: Learned result
stages.en: The learned graph after 1 round and 64 intervention images.

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Branch check: hold the near lane. The learned graph remains frozen.

stages.name: primary_hold

stages.name: root_retract

stages.name: observe
stages.en: Wait for the scene to settle; the learned graph remains frozen.

stages.name: Near branch verification
stages.en: Frozen image readings: F1=0, F3=0 (near); F2=1, F4=1 (far).

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Branch check: hold the far lane. The learned graph remains frozen.

scope: New seven-node physical fork simulation demonstration. Graph snapshots come from the frozen pixel/ACC discovery run; both branch holds and the bell hold are separate physical verifications. Not the paper aggregate or a calibration superiority experiment.
presentation: Recomposited original robot frames; fixed cameras; English-only captions and labels; graph states from discovery logs. Static cards and explicit resets added. Timing follows original replay frame cadence, not a real-time physics claim.
